# Release Intelligence Command Center v3

## Status Legend
- 🟢 Healthy: current data and no immediate action
- 🟠 Watch: partial data or upcoming change
- 🔴 Action: unavailable source or upgrade risk

## What to do first
1. Check **Action Required Components**
2. Review **Runtime Source Health**
3. Open **Upgrade Queue** for versions newer than running

This dashboard is designed for fast operations triage: more signal, fewer raw tables.

1.title: Action Required Components
1.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | summarize runtime_issue = countIf(source_status != "current"), by: { component } | join [ load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter is_latest == "true" | summarize upgrade_issue = countIf(is_newer_than_running == "true"), by: { component } ], on: { component } | fieldsAdd upgrade_issue = right.upgrade_issue | summarize action_required = countIf(runtime_issue > 0 or upgrade_issue > 0)

2.title: Components In Watch State
2.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | summarize runtime_watch = countIf(source_status == "partial" or source_status == "not_configured"), by: { component } | join [ load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | summarize release_watch = countIf(release_status != "current" or is_next_planned == "true"), by: { component } ], on: { component } | fieldsAdd release_watch = right.release_watch | summarize watch_components = countIf(runtime_watch > 0 or release_watch > 0)

3.title: Data Freshness (Release + Runtime)
3.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | summarize latest_release_fetch = max(fetched_at) | fieldsAdd join_key = "global" | join [ load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | summarize latest_runtime_fetch = max(observed_at) | fieldsAdd join_key = "global" ], on: { join_key } | fields latest_release_fetch, latest_runtime_fetch = right.latest_runtime_fetch

4.title: Runtime Source Health
4.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | summarize rows = count(), by: { component, source_status } | fieldsAdd status_badge = if(source_status == "current", "🟢 current", else: if(source_status == "partial", "🟠 partial", else: if(source_status == "not_configured", "🟠 not configured", else: "🔴 unavailable"))) | sort component asc, source_status asc

5.title: Release Radar (Top Published Versions)
5.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter released_version != "" and released_version != "Not yet published" | summarize rows = count(), by: { component, released_version } | sort component asc, released_version desc

6.title: Upgrade Queue (Newer Than Running)
6.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter is_latest == "true" and released_version != "" and released_version != "Not yet published" | fields component, running_version, latest_published = released_version, is_newer_than_running, release_url, fetched_at | fieldsAdd action = if(is_newer_than_running == "true", "🔴 newer available", else: if(running_version == "" or running_version == "-", "🟠 runtime unknown", else: "🟢 aligned")), action_priority = if(is_newer_than_running == "true", 1, else: if(running_version == "" or running_version == "-", 2, else: 3)) | fields component, running_version, latest_published, action, release_url, fetched_at, action_priority | sort action_priority asc, component asc | fields component, running_version, latest_published, action, release_url, fetched_at

7.title: AI Risk and Highlights (Latest Rows)
7.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter is_latest == "true" | fields component, released_version, risk = if(breaking_changes_summary == "" or breaking_changes_summary == "-", "No breaking changes extracted", else: breaking_changes_summary), highlights = if(highlights_summary == "" or highlights_summary == "-", "No highlights extracted", else: highlights_summary), release_url | sort component asc

## SaaS Rollout Expectations

- SaaS updates roll out progressively by Dynatrace-managed waves.
- A published release may appear before your tenant receives it.
- Treat **newer available** as planning signal, not automatic incident.

Use this order for enterprise response:
1. Validate scope (which components are behind).
2. Review breaking changes and rollout notes.
3. Trigger admin notification workflow when action is needed.
